info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_Appointment Management API
info.description: The Patient Appointment Scheduling API enables healthcare providers to efficiently manage patient appointments. This API allows users to create and schedule new appointments for patients, ensuring availability and streamlined coordination. Typical consumers include healthcare professionals, administrative staff, and integrated healthcare systems looking to enhance patient experience and operational efficiency. By utilizing this API, users can minimize scheduling conflicts and improve overall service delivery within their practices.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new appointment by providing the necessary details. Make sure to include all required fields for the appointment in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new appointment. It should include all necessary details such as the appointment date, time, attendee information, and any specific requirements or notes related to the appointment.

400.description: The request contains invalid parameters. Check and correct your input.

200.description: The appointment was successfully created and the operation was completed.

500.description: The server encountered an unexpected condition. Please try again later.
